business_problem: Cafe24 needed to expand the range of enterprise-grade AI models available through its LLM Router without sacrificing availability, performance, or the operational simplicity required to support diverse customer workloads.
solution_summary: Cafe24 extended its existing LLM Router by integrating Tencent Cloud TokenHub so merchants and developers can reach multiple generative AI models through one control plane instead of wiring each provider separately. Cafe24 LLM Router remains the front door for AI requests, handling unified access, real-time model routing, and automatic failover across supported models. Tencent Cloud TokenHub sits behind that router and exposes multiple leading large language models through a single OpenAI-compatible API, letting Cafe24 broaden the model portfolio without adding one-off integrations for every vendor. This architecture supports AI features across Cafe24's broader commerce ecosystem, including product recommendations, marketing automation, and multilingual store operations, while preserving service continuity and flexible model choice. The result is a more resilient generative AI platform that shortens experimentation and deployment cycles for customers pursuing AI transformation.

data_flow: Cafe24 applications send AI requests to Cafe24 LLM Router, which routes them through Tencent Cloud TokenHub's OpenAI-compatible API to the selected model and fails over in real time when needed before responses return to commerce, marketing, and multilingual storefront workloads.
business_outcome: Cafe24 broadened model choice and simplified AI adoption by giving developers and businesses one API path to multiple LLMs, improving resilience and making experimentation, deployment, and AI transformation faster.
